dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Air pollution in northern Thailand. Every year, it gets worse.
dialogue.reading: ˈɛr pəˌluːʃən ɪn ˈnɔːrðərn ˈtaɪlænd. ˈɛvri ˈjɪr, ɪt ˈɡɛts ˈwɜːrs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Mostly smoke from forest fires and from farmers burning their fields.
dialogue.reading: ˈmoʊstli ˈsmoʊk frəm ˈfɔːrɪst ˌfaɪərz ənd frəm ˈfɑːrmərz ˈbɜːrnɪŋ ðɛr ˈfiːldz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, but its response was too slow. If they had taken action ten years ago, the air would be much cleaner now.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, bʌt ɪts rɪˈspɑːns wʌz ˈtuː ˈsloʊ. ɪf ðeɪ hæd ˈteɪkən ˈækʃən ˈtɛn ˈjɪrz əˈɡoʊ, ði ˈɛr wʊd bi ˈmʌtʃ ˈkliːnər ˈnaʊ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Have their new plans been effective?
dialogue.reading: hæv ðɛr ˈnuː ˈplænz bɪn ɪˈfɛktɪv?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not very. If farmers had been given other ways to prepare their fields, they wouldn't need to burn them now.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈvɛri. ɪf ˈfɑːrmərz hæd bɪn ˈɡɪvən ˈʌðər ˈweɪz tə prɪˈpɛr ðɛr ˈfiːldz, ðeɪ ˈwʊdənt ˈniːd tə ˈbɜːrn ðɛm ˈnaʊ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: So what's more important, prevention or response?
dialogue.reading: soʊ ˈwʌts ˈmɔːr ɪmˈpɔːrtənt, prɪˈvɛnʃən ɔːr rɪˈspɑːns?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Prevention, definitely. If we had spent more on prevention, we wouldn't have such a big problem today.
dialogue.reading: prɪˈvɛnʃən, ˈdɛfənətli. ɪf wiː hæd ˈspɛnt ˈmɔːr ɑːn prɪˈvɛnʃən, wiː ˈwʊdənt ˈhæv ˈsʌtʃ ə ˈbɪɡ ˈprɑːbləm təˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: And if you were in charge, what would you have done differently?
dialogue.reading: ənd ɪf juː wɜːr ɪn ˈtʃɑːrdʒ, ˈwʌt wʊd juː hæv ˈdʌn ˈdɪfərəntli?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: If I were in charge, I would have helped farmers years ago. Now it's much harder.
dialogue.reading: ɪf aɪ wɜːr ɪn ˈtʃɑːrdʒ, aɪ wʊd hæv ˈhɛlpt ˈfɑːrmərz ˈjɪrz əˈɡoʊ. ˈnaʊ ɪts ˈmʌtʃ ˈhɑːrdər.
